description: This PHP source file defines the SaleOrder controller class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It handles functionalities related to sales order reporting, including rendering report forms, saving configurations, fetching report data, and outputting views. The class interacts with language files, models, URL generators, and response handlers to facilitate reporting features in the admin interface.

classes.name: SaleOrder
classes.description: Controller class managing sales order reports in the admin panel, providing methods for displaying, saving, and retrieving reports, as well as constructing breadcrumb navigation and pagination.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language, sets page title, prepares data including breadcrumbs and view components, and renders the sale order report form.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes saving of report configuration settings, checks permissions, and returns success or error status as JSON.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates and displays the sales order report view, including order data and status filters.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of sales orders by invoking getReport method.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves filtered report data based on request parameters, manages pagination, and returns the report as a view.
